title: Cabbage: modeled ₹246/qtl left, Dhanotu (Mandi) → Kangra (Baijnath)
summary: January 2025: reported cabbage prices at Dhanotu (Mandi) and Kangra (Baijnath) imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 77% of 26 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹246 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 1,296 same-variety market pairs screened for cabbage in January 2025; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Kangra (Baijnath) report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: January 2025
scenes.caption: Dhanotu (Mandi) (Himachal Pradesh) and Kangra (Baijnath) (Himachal Pradesh) both reported cabbage prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 26 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Dhanotu (Mandi) reported a median ₹850 per quintal. Kangra (Baijnath) reported a median ₹1,150 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹375/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹375 per quintal, and Kangra (Baijnath) was dearer on 96% of days.

scenes.headline: 150 km by road

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress

scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹75/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Cabbage route from Thanesar to Palampur was positive on 80% of matched days in October 2025. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹72,500, or ₹52,600 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
